column1: # Ruling texts left OPEN for a named reason (worker.md, rulings brief (c) UNCOVERED): every card they apply to is unsupported, or the engine lacks the behavior and the fix is not small. scripts/rulings_batches.py has no such status, so finish-line-plan criterion C1 reconciles its OPEN count against this list. One line per text: Card<TAB>substring of the ruling<TAB>reason.

column2: A one-time boon is a single-use triggered ability with no source
column3: the only card is unsupported: boons are a digital-only mechanic (docs/DEFERRED.md, digital-only cards); the paper printing is legal only in Arena formats

column2: In an Un- game, if X is actually infinite
column3: deferred: the ruling is about an infinite X, i.e. infinite mana, which only Urza's Fun House ({T}: Add {∞}) can make, an acorn card not legal in any format (docs/DEFERRED.md, cards not legal in any format), in an Un- game; the CR's numbers are integers (CR 107.1) and the engine has no infinite ones

column2: You do get to choose which lands get tapped.
column3: the engine lacks the behavior: a spell's mana cost is paid by the automatic payment planner (mana_abilities.rs, pay_mana), with no decision about which sources to tap or which of a land's mana abilities to use; a player chooses only by activating mana abilities while they have priority, and a card played during Word of Command's resolution is played with no priority, so its controller can't pick the lands or a tap-and-sacrifice mana ability (rulings-P115, 2026-11-19)

column2: but an opponent casts it (due to Knowledge Pool's effect, for example)
column3: the engine lacks the behavior: a shuffle is recorded only as its library's owner shuffling (Event::Shuffled { player }, game.rs shuffle_library), with no record of which player shuffles, so when an opponent casts P0's Green Sun's Zenith and shuffles it into P0's library, "shuffle their library" triggers (Psychogenic Probe, Cosi's Trickster, Psychic Surgery, Widespread Panic) still see P0 shuffle (checked: Psychogenic Probe deals P0 2 damage). The searching and both zone moves are right. The fix needs the shuffling player on every shuffle event (matched in some 50 test files) and each "shuffle ~ into its owner's library" attributed to the player its text names (Green Sun's Zenith's caster, Chaos Warp's owner), not small (rulings-P168, 2026-11-19)

column2: If cards in your graveyard have multiple hexproof abilities
column3: the engine lacks the behavior and the fix is not small: keyword counters exist only for the fifteen keywords CR 122.1b lists (layers.rs KEYWORD_COUNTERS), not for their variants (a "hexproof from white" counter), and Kathril's compiled "repeat this process" checks HasKeyword(Hexproof), which any hexproof variant matches, so one hexproof counter is put for all of them (rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: In some unusual cases, Comet may gain loyalty abilities other than the one he normally has
column3: no supported card or effect gives a planeswalker another planeswalker's loyalty abilities while keeping its own (Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God gives the other walkers' abilities to Bolas, not to them), so the case the ruling describes can't be set up (rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: You can choose Drop Tower’s effect for Grand Marshal Macie’s last ability
column3: the ruling is about Grand Marshal Macie, an acorn card not legal in any format (docs/DEFERRED.md, cards not legal in any format); Drop Tower's own effect is tested in tests/cards/c5_attractions.rs (rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: If the back face of a modal double-faced card is a creature with mana value 4 or greater
column3: engine: a spell is cast with one CastMethod, so the back face of a modal double-faced card (CastMethod::Half) can't also be cast with an alternative cost such as the blitz Henzie grants; combining them is not a small fix (rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: As you cast Invoke the Firemind, first you choose the mode
column3: engine: a spell's X is announced before its modes (casting.rs asks ChooseX, then stack.rs choose_modes_and_targets asks the modes with the targets), where CR 601.2b announces the modes first; reordering the casting steps is not a small fix: the greatest feasible X (default_x.rs spell_x_feasible) and the modes offered (those with legal targets for that X) would have to be computed from each other the other way, for spells and abilities (register x-announced-before-modes, a documented deviation the user accepted on 2026-11-20; rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: Every player gets to know whether a card is going to the top or bottom of any library.
column3: engine and API lack the behavior: the owner's top-or-bottom choice is a ChooseOption only that player sees, and neither Event::ZoneChange nor mtg-api's event feed records a library position, so the other players are never told; recording it means a new field on the zone-change event and its every constructor, not a small fix (rulings-residue-misc-2, 2026-11-20)

column2: If you use Agent of Acquisitions to draft a booster pack containing Lore Seeker
column3: deferred: the ruling is only about drafting with Agent of Acquisitions (draft a whole booster pack), one of the Conspiracy face-down draft cards docs/DEFERRED.md leaves out, which the draft model (draft.rs) doesn't support; without it the situation (a Lore Seeker pack drafted whole, with a new pack added) can't arise (rulings-residue-misc-1, 2026-11-20)
